summary: TOP Ships Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, announcing the sale of 100% of the shares of an SPV holding a shipbuilding contract for a 47,499 dwt chemical/product oil carrier newbuilding to Rubico Inc., a related party. The aggregate selling price is approximately US$6.5 million, payable in cash at closing. The transaction is expected to close by September 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions. A special committee of independent directors approved the sale after receiving a fairness opinion from an independent financial advisor. What to watch: the related-party nature and close of the deal within two months; risk-arb angle is minimal given fixed cash price and no financing condition.
